notes.title: HAPPY NEW YEAR!
notes.content:
The Meat Fest team is in touch.

We have been working non-stop on our game for a year and a half now. We are currently preparing to participate in the Steam Next Fest in February, which means that the release is not long away. One of the main changes for us is that we have added a feedback form that will help us improve our work. But we cannot do this without you, so we ask for your help!

List of changes:

1. Tutorial level. Before starting the first level, you will receive an offer to complete it
2. Short feedback form in the main menu and at the end of the demo
3. Better developed environment at the levels
4. Improved tablet design
5. New main menu design

We will fix the Chinese/Korean/Japanese localization soon.

[b]HAPPY NEW YEAR![/b]

P.S. Please fill out the Google form, it is important for us!

Google Form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdQp5Ggrs9sy3clEhCwV00aQGQ1XodAsiihgKUgH3Cjyo3jaw/viewform?usp=sharing

notes.title: First demo update
notes.content:
Hello! Today we have a big update.

[b]List of changes:[/b]

1. Added 3 languages ​​for subtitles and interface (Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese)
2. New HUD interface
3. Added special ability of weapon 1 ( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XcX2PQHbANc )
4. Minor changes for a more comfortable game

[i]We are gradually updating unfinished places in the demo, which will also be in the release, and at the same time preparing new content that will not be included in the demo.[/i]

[b]Nearest plans:[/b]

- New interface for tablet
- Encyclopedia of samples

[u]We will be glad to receive feedback! Good luck![/u]

notes.title: First start
notes.content:
We are glad to welcome you to our first project!

By opening access to the demo version, we invite you to familiarize yourself with our views and encourage you to actively participate in the development of the project. Now, at the first stage, more than ever, we need your help. We will be grateful if you share your thoughts and emotions after completing the demo.

Nearest plans:
[list]
[*] New interface and tablet menu
[*] Switch to Russian voice acting
[/list]

Thank you for your attention and have a nice day!
